title: China's chip expansion stalls on two-year tool waits, and missing parts are to blame
summary: China's foundries keep adding capacity, but longer equipment lead times are starting to slow them down. SMIC says the global semiconductor equipment supply chain remains tight. title: Phone chip demand may stay weak in 2027, recovery seen in 2028
summary: Research firms and industry sources expect the smartphone market to remain sluggish in 2027, with a more noticeable recovery potentially not arriving until 2028.
